title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The improved food and livelihood security programme in Chad implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to address the food security, health and nutrition needs of displaced and host households. The objectives of the programme is to improve the food security of host and IDP communities through support to improved vegetable yields to increase dietary diversity; to support livelihood diversity; and to reduce the prevalence, mortality and morbidity associated with acute malnutrition working with local health centres and households . The food security response within the framework of this project is underpinned by support for market gardening, agriculture based income generating activities and fishing associations. Support is offered at household level and includes agricultural inputs and training on diverse crops for increase dietary diversity.
